intro.text: The author of Seor's Encyclopedia of Political Myths, a book exposing the false claims of Fjorden and the Derethi church.

items.text: Sarene, who found the book fascinating, showed it to Spirit because it holds the original form of the poem Wyrn the King. Derethi priests had altered the poem to make the first Wyrn seem Derethi and to turn Jaddeth, once a lesser god, into the religion's supreme deity. Sarene thought Fjorden had suppressed the original, which would badly embarrass them if it came out.
